name: Asymmetric Wing Stroke
definition: A method to generate realistic wing flapping motion by using an asymmetric cycle where the downstroke is quick (36% of the period) and the recovery/coast is slower (64% of the period), avoiding the mechanical look of a symmetric sine wave.
summary: Asymmetric Wing Stroke is a time-dependent function generating non-sinusoidal flapping motions for procedural volume rendering by mimicking biological snap-and-coast kinematics with rapid power and slow recovery strokes.
